chapter_en: Chapter 22: Changing one's name and taking over another's register

units.chapter_en: Chapter 22: Changing one's name and taking over another's register
units.title: 更名顶籍：以世爻为主、官鬼为凭；欲顶他人籍与名六冲定见叹吁声、世空世破咸非就、官绝官亡尽不成；凡改姓名及顶他人户籍主不成

rule.yi: 想顶替别人的户籍和姓名，以世爻为主，以官鬼为凭据：遇到六冲，一定听到叹息声；世爻空、世爻破，都办不成；官爻绝、官爻亡，全都不成。凡是改换姓名、顶替别人户籍的，主不成。
rule.en: In wanting to take over another's register and name, take the Self line as the chief and Pressure as the ground: with a six-clash one will surely hear sighs; if the Self is Void or broken, in neither case is it accomplished; if the star of office is extinct or lost, it all fails. Changing one's name and taking over another's household register is judged not to succeed.

yi: 以世爻为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the Self line as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 欲顶他人籍与名，六冲定见叹吁声，
世空世破咸非就，官绝官亡尽不成。
yi: 想顶替别人的户籍和姓名，遇到六冲，一定听到叹息声；
世爻空、世爻破，都办不成；官爻绝、官爻亡，全都不成。
en: If one wants to take over another's register and name, a six-clash will surely bring sighs;
if the Self is Void or broken, in neither case is it accomplished; if the star of office is extinct or lost, it all fails.

zh: 凡改姓名及顶他人户籍主不成。
yi: 凡是改换姓名、顶替别人户籍的，主不成。
en: Changing one's name and taking over another's household register is judged not to succeed.

note.yi: 章名在书里出现两次，头一次写作「更吊顶籍」，「吊」是「名」的误写。「顶籍」是顶替别人的户籍（名册上的名额）；「叹吁」是叹息。「凡改姓名及顶他人户籍主不成」这一句紧接在讲不成的诀后面，按上下文是对前面那几种情形的总结，书里没有写出条件，这里照字面译。这一章与谋差顶役（EL.106 起）是一类：不是顶一个役位，而是顶别人的名、籍和营业。
note.en: The chapter title is written twice in the book, the first time as 'geng diao ding ji', where the 'diao' is a miswriting of 'ming'. 'Ding ji' is taking over another's household register (a place on the roll); 'tanxu' is sighing. The sentence 'changing one's name and taking over another's household register is judged not to succeed' follows straight after the verse about failure and is by the context a summary of the cases just given; the book states no condition and it is translated literally. This chapter is of a kind with the chapters on seeking a commission and taking over a service (from EL.106): not taking over a service post but taking over another's name, register and business.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 22: Changing one's name and taking over another's register
units.title: 更名顶籍：更此官名宜鬼旺、顶其店业要财兴，兄临雀动伤身世犹恐傍人举斗争，世不空冲官不陷事当圆就永无更；在官顶补姓名尤要官爻旺相又不可鬼克世身，顶人艺业还求财象兴隆不拘公私更改兄爻独发难成，纵然乱动兄带朱雀克世或应带朱雀克世必有傍人举首争夺，世爻兴官爻不空冲破绝事事皆成

rule.yi: 顶补官名（官职），适宜官鬼旺相；顶替别人的店铺产业，要财爻兴旺。兄爻临朱雀发动，伤克身爻、世爻，还怕旁人出来争斗；世爻不空不冲、官不落陷，事情当可圆成，永不更改。在官府顶补姓名，尤其要官爻旺相，又不可官鬼克世爻、身爻；顶替别人的手艺行业，还要财象兴隆；不论公家还是私人的更改，兄爻独发就难成；即使乱动，如果兄爻带朱雀发动来克世，或者应爻带朱雀来克世，必有旁人出头争夺；世爻兴旺、官爻都不空、不冲、不破、不绝，事事都成。
rule.en: To take over an official name, it is fitting for Pressure to be thriving; to take over another's shop and business, Wealth must flourish. If Peer on the Vermilion Bird moves and hurts the Body or the Self, one still fears bystanders rising to contend; if the Self is neither Void nor clashed and the star of office is not sunk, the matter will be fully accomplished and never changed. In taking over a name in an official post, it is especially necessary for the Pressure line to be thriving, and Pressure must not control the Self or the Body; in taking over another's craft or trade, one still wants the Wealth image to flourish; whether the change is public or private, if the Peer line moves alone it is hard to accomplish; even if lines move in confusion, if Peer carrying the Vermilion Bird moves to control the Self, or the Other carrying the Vermilion Bird comes to control the Self, there will surely be bystanders who come forward to contend; if the Self is thriving and the Pressure line is not Void, clashed, broken or extinct, everything succeeds.

zh: 更此官名宜鬼旺，顶其店业要财兴。
兄临雀动伤身世，犹恐傍人举斗争。
世不空冲官不陷，事当圆就永无更。
yi: 顶补官名（官职），适宜官鬼旺相；顶替别人的店铺产业，要财爻兴旺。
兄爻临朱雀发动，伤克身爻、世爻，还怕旁人出来争斗；
世爻不空不冲、官不落陷，事情当可圆成，永不更改。
en: To take over an official name, it is fitting for Pressure to be thriving; to take over another's shop and business, Wealth must flourish.
If Peer on the Vermilion Bird moves and hurts the Body or the Self, one still fears bystanders rising to contend;
if the Self is neither Void nor clashed and the star of office is not sunk, the matter will be fully accomplished and never changed.

zh: 在官顶补姓名，尤要官爻旺相，又不可鬼克世身。
顶人艺业，还求财象兴隆，不拘公私更改，兄爻独发难成。
纵然乱动，兄带朱雀动来克世，或应带朱雀来克世者，必有傍人举首争夺成非，世爻兴官爻若皆不空冲破绝，事事皆成无谋不遂。
yi: 在官府顶补姓名，尤其要官爻旺相，又不可官鬼克世爻、身爻。
顶替别人的手艺行业，还要财象兴隆；不论公家还是私人的更改，兄爻独发就难成。
即使乱动，如果兄爻带朱雀发动来克世，或者应爻带朱雀来克世，必有旁人出头争夺；世爻兴旺、官爻都不空、不冲、不破、不绝，事事都成。
en: In taking over a name in an official post, it is especially necessary for the Pressure line to be thriving, and Pressure must not control the Self or the Body.
In taking over another's craft or trade, one still wants the Wealth image to flourish; whether the change is public or private, if the Peer line moves alone it is hard to accomplish.

Even if lines move in confusion, if Peer carrying the Vermilion Bird moves to control the Self, or the Other carrying the Vermilion Bird comes to control the Self, there will surely be bystanders who come forward to contend; if the Self is thriving and the Pressure line is not Void, clashed, broken or extinct, everything succeeds.

note.yi: 「顶补」是顶替补缺；「艺业」是手艺行业；「店业」是店铺产业；「举首」是出头；「傍人」是旁人。「更此官名」按解里「在官顶补姓名」读，指顶补官府里的名额。这一条的取法和谋差顶役（EL.106 起）一样：官爻旺相、财爻兴旺是吉，兄爻带朱雀来克世是旁人来争。
note.en: 'Dingbu' is taking over a place to fill a vacancy; 'yiye' is a craft or trade; 'dianye' is a shop and its business; 'jushou' is coming forward; 'bangren' is bystanders. 'Geng ci guan ming' is read by the explanation's 'taking over a name in an official post' and means taking over a place on the roll in an office. The method here is the same as in the chapters on seeking a commission (from EL.106): the Pressure line thriving and Wealth flourishing are auspicious, and Peer carrying the Vermilion Bird coming to control the Self is bystanders coming to contend.
